be loyal to one's country: Even after living abroad for thirty years, the old soldier was still loyal to his country and proud of it.
即使在國外住了三十年，那位老兵仍然忠於國家，並以它為榮。
a loyal customer: As a loyal customer who has shopped at this bakery for ten years, Mrs. Lin gets a free cake every birthday.
林太太是在這家麵包店買了十年的忠實顧客，每年生日都能拿到免費蛋糕。
remain loyal: Although the team lost almost every game this season, its fans remain loyal and still fill the stadium each week.
雖然這支球隊本季幾乎每場都輸，球迷們依然保持忠誠，每週照樣把球場坐滿。
loyal supporters: The singer thanked her loyal supporters, who had followed her from small cafés to sold-out concerts.
這位歌手感謝她的忠實的支持者，他們從小咖啡館一路追隨她到門票售罄的演唱會。
a luxurious hotel: For their honeymoon they stayed in a luxurious hotel with marble floors, a private pool, and a butler.
他們度蜜月時住在一間有大理石地板、私人泳池和管家的豪華飯店。
a luxurious lifestyle: After winning the lottery, he started a luxurious lifestyle of sports cars, designer clothes, and first-class flights.
中了樂透後，他開始過起跑車、名牌服飾和頭等艙的奢華的生活方式。
luxurious fabrics: The queen's gown was made from luxurious fabrics such as soft silk and velvet that cost a fortune.
女王的禮服是用柔軟的絲綢和天鵝絨等價格昂貴的高級布料製成的。
a magical moment: Seeing snow for the first time was a magical moment for the children from tropical Taiwan.
第一次看到雪，對來自熱帶台灣的孩子們來說是奇妙的時刻。
magical powers: In the fairy tale, the old woman uses her magical powers to turn the pumpkin into a golden carriage.
在童話故事裡，老婦人用她的魔力把南瓜變成一輛金色馬車。
a magical experience: Swimming with dolphins in the clear blue sea was a magical experience that I will never forget.
在清澈的藍色大海裡和海豚一起游泳，是我永遠不會忘記的奇妙的經驗。
a magnetic personality: With her magnetic personality, the new teacher draws students to her like iron to a magnet.
新老師擁有極具魅力的個性，像磁鐵吸鐵一樣把學生吸引到她身邊。
a magnetic field: A compass needle points north because it follows the magnetic field that surrounds the Earth.
指南針會指向北方，是因為它順著環繞地球的磁場。
magnetic attraction: The two stars felt a strong magnetic attraction, as if an invisible force kept pulling them toward each other.
兩位明星感受到強烈的吸引力，彷彿有一股無形的力量不斷把他們拉向彼此。
a magnetic strip: The card reader could not read my ticket because the magnetic strip on the back was scratched.
讀卡機讀不到我的車票，因為背面的磁條被刮傷了。
a magnificent view: From the top of Taipei 101, visitors can enjoy a magnificent view of the whole city and the mountains beyond.
從台北101頂樓，遊客可以欣賞到整座城市和遠方群山的壯麗的景色。
a magnificent performance: With stunning costumes, a huge stage, and a hundred dancers, the show was a magnificent performance on every level.
憑著驚豔的服裝、巨大的舞台和一百位舞者，這場演出在各方面都是精彩絕倫的表演。
a magnificent achievement: Climbing Mount Everest at the age of seventy was a magnificent achievement that made headlines around the world.
七十歲登上聖母峰是一項非凡的成就，登上了全球新聞頭條。
a manifest error: The judge said the earlier decision contained a manifest error that anyone reading the documents could clearly see.
法官說先前的判決有一個明顯的錯誤，任何閱讀文件的人都看得清清楚楚。
manifest destiny: In the 1800s, many Americans believed in manifest destiny, the idea that their nation was meant to spread across the continent.
在十九世紀，許多美國人相信天命論，認為他們的國家注定要擴展到整個大陸。
be made manifest: The company's dishonesty was made manifest when the secret emails were shown to the public on the evening news.
當秘密電子郵件在晚間新聞中公開時，這家公司的不誠實變得顯而易見。
manifest itself in: Stress often manifests itself in headaches, poor sleep, and a loss of appetite during exam season.
考試季期間，壓力常常以頭痛、失眠和食慾不振的形式顯現。
manual labor: Moving furniture and lifting heavy boxes all day is manual labor that leaves your back and arms sore.
整天搬家具、扛重箱子是會讓背和手臂痠痛的體力勞動。
a manual worker: My grandfather was a manual worker who built roads with his hands for forty years.
我祖父是一名體力勞動者，四十年來用雙手修築道路。
manual transmission: My father's old car has a manual transmission, so you need to use the clutch and change gears yourself.
我爸爸的舊車是手排，所以你必須自己踩離合器、換檔。
a user's manual: If the printer stops working, check the user's manual first; it explains how to fix the most common problems.
如果印表機故障，先查看使用手冊；裡面說明了如何解決最常見的問題。
manual dexterity: Surgeons and piano players both need excellent manual dexterity to move their fingers quickly and accurately.
外科醫生和鋼琴家都需要極佳的手部靈巧度，才能讓手指快速又精準地移動。
marine life: Plastic bags in the ocean are a serious threat to marine life such as turtles, fish, and whales.
海洋中的塑膠袋對烏龜、魚類和鯨魚等海洋生物構成嚴重威脅。
marine biology: Because she loves sharks and coral reefs, my sister plans to study marine biology at university.
因為熱愛鯊魚和珊瑚礁，我姊姊打算在大學念海洋生物學。
the Marine Corps: After high school, he joined the Marine Corps and was trained to fight both on land and at sea.
高中畢業後，他加入了海軍陸戰隊，接受陸上和海上作戰的訓練。
marine pollution: Oil spills from ships are one of the main causes of marine pollution, killing countless sea birds and fish.
船隻漏油是海洋污染的主要原因之一，害死無數海鳥和魚類。
